prompt: 请按 scene-hook-check 的清单把这篇 newsletter 草稿逐条过一遍，四个 Part 都要检查，给我完整的检查结果和自检卡打分。/scene-hook-check
assertions: The self-check card is NOT output or filled in, even though the user explicitly asked for 自检卡打分
